entities.name: Query 448-aa fusion protein
observations: Sequence length 448 aa; estimated molecular mass 47.6 kDa and theoretical pI 5.68.
N-terminal residues 7-202 match Pfam Hydrolase PF00702.33, described as a haloacid-dehalogenase-like hydrolase domain.
C-terminal residues 255-441 match Pfam Aldolase_II PF00596.28 with very strong significance (independent E-value 1.9e-35).
Strong Swiss-Prot sequence hits cover approximately the N-terminal half and have names containing MtnC; annotation transfer was not accepted by the analysis pipeline.
No transmembrane segment or secretion signal is evident from the sequence architecture; cytosolic localization is inferred.
Exact catalytic reactions, metal specificity, oligomeric state, and in-vivo coupling of the two domains remain unconfirmed.

entities.name: Methionine salvage pathway
observations: MtnC-like homolog naming suggests possible participation in bacterial methylthioadenosine/methionine salvage, but this assignment is homology-based and not directly curated for the query protein.

entities.name: Glycolysis / central carbon metabolism
observations: The C-terminal Aldolase_II domain is compatible with class-II aldolase chemistry and may connect to fructose-phosphate metabolism, but canonical fructose-1,6-bisphosphate aldolase activity is not proven for this fusion.
Aldolase-II family members commonly use a divalent metal, often Zn2+; this is a family-level expectation rather than a demonstrated property of the query protein.
